---
title: "What value marks the 75th percentile of my observations?"
---

## What the question asks

What value marks the 75th percentile of my observations?

## Steps in RStudio

1. Enter numeric observations.

2. Convert 75 percent to probability .75.

3. Run quantile(x,probs=.75).

## Runnable example

```{r}
x <- c(10,12,15,19,23,26,31,40)
print(quantile(x,probs=.75))
```

## Interpret the result

With R's default quantile method, the 75th-percentile cutoff is 27.25. It is an interpolated sample threshold and need not be one of the observed values.

## Check before applying this to real data

Different percentile algorithms can give different thresholds for small samples. Do not confuse rank with value.
